SECTION 07 // FAQ

FAQ

◆ What is GANGSTER?

7,777 gangsters on BNB Chain. Six ranks — Street Punk, Hustler, Enforcer, Boss, Kingpin and the mythic Godfather. Each mint is a random draw from the six ranks.

◆ How much does a mint cost?

Your first mint per wallet is FREE — with no cap on free mints. After that, bundles: 1 for 0.0001 BNB, 2 for 0.00015, 5 for 0.0004, 10 for 0.0008 BNB. You always pay BNB gas on top.

◆ How many can I mint?

Max 10 gangsters per wallet and max 10 per transaction. Your free mint counts as 1 of the 10.

◆ How does the marketplace work?

List your gangster on this site — the NFT is held by the market contract (escrow) while listed. Buyers pay in BNB, the seller receives 95% and a 5% fee goes to the collection owner. You can cancel your listing any time to get your gangster back.

◆ Is there a token?

Yes. Every Gangster NFT claims 10,000 $GANG — once per NFT. The claim fee is 0.0004 BNB per NFT, and $GANG is minted straight to your wallet on claim. Cap: 100,000,000 $GANG. No presale, no staking. Claim your $GANG here →
